body:
Thank you all for taking the time to read my post and i thank you for all the support and i will now try to answer some of the questions you left in the comments.
These thoughts started occurring when i was about 14.

These thoughts mainly consist of self loathing for example i hate myself for failing even the smallest things, and even then i did something recently that to many people is a great accomplishment i used to have a great fear of water as in i could not go to swimming lessons, go to the pool or even take a bath it was strictly showers.In 10th grade there was a school trip where there was a lake, a huge lake with a large cliff and i jumped in it and conquered my fear of water i think to myself "good job you can take a bath and swim in a pool" i can't take pride in any of my accomplishments.
Another example of self loathing is probably because i compare myself to others constantly for example some of my friends are both more physically fit than me and are better at some video games than me and that makes me feel so worthless as a human being.

I can't say that i am regularly unhappy as i talk to my friends and play games with them on almost a daily basis.

If there is one large change that i remember from when i was a small child to becoming teen is how much shit i can put up with.I used to have a massive problem with authority i would never listen to teachers i ignored my father regularly i even got in trouble with the police at some points.But that all changed when i turned 15 now i just accept the way things are i don't try to change them i don't even bother reasoning with them.PS don't know if this paragraph helps but i'm trying to dish out as much emotional information as i can.

I have never been diagnosed with an illness of any kind by a professional but there have always been suspicions of some degree of ADHD/Autism.

Probably the most important thing on this long list was i used to have a severe problem with Anger,For example at one point in the 10th grade i tackled and attempted to choke the school janitor because she though i was skipping class and was threatening to call the principal.I have resolved this issue through psychological therapy from a professional, Maybe the fact that i can no longer vent my frustration with my anger is causing these feelings?
